about: The highlight end rule on both sides of the parity pair: worker/highlights.py _segment_bounds and src/app/api/highlights/endPolicy.ts automaticHighlightEnd. clip_pre is null for an automatic match (the established rule, unchanged) and the match's clip pad for a hand cut, where cut_t0 is the padded clip start. expected_end is the segment's end on the cut clock, tail included.

cases.name: automatic match keeps the established rule
automatic tight start is ignored without a pad
hand cut counts the end from the padded clip start
hand cut tight start uses the adjust_point pad
hand cut point in the first second clamps its clip start at zero
hand cut with an observed cut-clock end uses it
hand cut scoring tap stays authoritative
